summary: EuroDry Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $20,000,000 of common shares through sole sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners under an equity distribution agreement dated September 11, 2026. Shares trade on Nasdaq under EDRY, last reported at $63.89 on September 10, 2026. A.G.P. receives 3.0% of gross sales price; no escrow arrangement exists. Each share carries a rights-plan purchase right. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and share-price pressure from ATM sales.
